title: Research sprint goal: Facts carry their freshness at lookup: stamp, revalidation, gone repositories and per-section hashes
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Research 2026-10-12: findings written to kb/public/agents/doc-change-detection.md (GitHub 404 and rate-limit semantics, GitLab.com gone-project route and limits, hash-only host headers) and answer QK-gone-repository-check-limits-hash-only-hosts in _answers.md; open raw-host limit in _gaps.md under agents/doc-change-detection. Already in the kb and not re-researched: per-source freshness lifetimes and the offline stamp inputs (QK-fact-freshness-at-lookup), heading and fence rule for sections (agents/codebase-mapping.md:42), hook 30 s (claude/hooks.md:60), MCP idle 5 min (agents/agent-error-catalogue.csv:19). Planning input: the kb's non-superseded pinned sources name 278 GitHub repositories and 7 GitLab projects (counted from _sources.csv), more than 60 unauthenticated REST requests an hour, so a whole-kb repository check has to go through the raw file route (not charged to the core counter on one probe; its limit undocumented) or a selection.
